Zero. Zilch. Nada. That’s how many HOT squeezes we’ve got on the board today. You gotta be kidding me, right? Zero out of zero? That’s what the squeeze data is screaming right now. If you’re looking for the market to gift-wrap some obvious high-momentum setups, well, my friend, you’re wasting your time. The tape is telling us something, and you better be listening: **risk sentiment is frozen solid, and the froth is nowhere to be found.**

Zooming out, this fits the macro backdrop perfectly. Last week’s CPI print came in cool, the Fed’s been playing footsie with a “maybe we’re done hiking” narrative, and the dollar is coiling tighter than a spring. Are you exhausted yet? Because the market might be. Here’s your cheat code for a messy week: focus on what’s holding up when everything else is choking on macro uncertainty. But more importantly, pay attention to the silence. No HOT setups? That’s a clue. It’s not giving us “rip higher” vibes yet, but the bears? They’ve got nothing. This is chop… but it’s constructive chop.

Now, let’s comb through our names. This isn’t the time to go YOLO smash on anything that moves, but we’ve got some absolute studs in the lineup. $MP out of the rare earth space? Still a star, still running laps around its peers with a 122% move off our entry. That’s leadership. $UUUU has been a monster too, another one where we’ve already taken half off at 2x. Between these two, you’ve got rare earths and nuclear charging forward while the market catches its breath. Energy is another standout — $OXY and $APA are quietly climbing, and you don’t take that lightly when crude’s trying to find its next move.

For late entries, let’s talk actionables. $NIO isn’t done yet, period. The setup we sniffed out at $0.29? That thing is just getting started. Add to it? Nah. But if you’re late to the party, it’s still a decent RSVP while we’re holding two full positions. And look at $CF. Agriculture might not be sexy, but that 23% pop since we got in? Pure bankroll fuel, and it still feels like it’s coiling for more.

So what’s today about? Watch the dollar. A clean breakout or breakdown will tell us everything about the next move for stocks and commodities. Also, keep your eyes on rare earth and uranium — the folks in DC keep jawboning about critical minerals, and the market’s whispering back. Lastly, don’t sleep on crypto. $ETHA, $BLSH, $BMNR, $COIN… these aren’t just charts; these are names with momentum in a market lacking it.

Risk is on, but cautiously. Full stop. If the squeeze radar is blank, it means the momentum crowd is on ice. But if this market has taught us anything, the only thing worse than being early is being late. Let’s keep our swords sharp — rotation is coming. Are you ready to strike?
